method: Native KiCad saved polygons, 0.5um inscribed approximation; 1.1um comparison guard; exact nominal via dimensions. Both copper layers and resolved pad mask apertures, tented vias respected.
recipe: 35um two-layer standard copper parameters; only explicitly enabled J2 ring/web or legend factory-limit concessions are permitted.
scope: Geometric manufacturing rules only. Native DRC connectivity/parity, zone refill consistency, solder assembly, impedance and EMC require separate checks.

assembly_observations.note: Resolve solder-wicking risk by assembly process or approved layout changes. Explicit via tenting cannot override an overlapping SMD pad mask aperture.
